artworks.title: Plate 46. City Creek Canon, near City Creek Falls
artworks.artist: Andrew Joseph Russell
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view, capturing a mountainous terrain. The horizon is obscured by the mountain slopes. A waterfall cascades down a rocky hillside, creating a mist-like effect where the water flows. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and brown. Snow covers rocks and tree branches in the foreground, with sparse vegetation and exposed roots adding texture to the ground. In the distance, trees climb up the slopes.

artworks.title: Plate 47. Residence of Brigham Young
artworks.artist: Andrew Joseph Russell
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a bird's eye view of a tree-lined street with architectural structures. There are mature trees and a path leading to buildings. To the right, there is a house with shutters and a fenced garden. Further away, there is a larger building with a unique roofline. In the background, there are mountains with a range of peaks and valleys. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a vintage feel. The image is detailed and sharp, highlighting textures and shapes.

artworks.title: Plate 48. Mormon Family, Great Salt Lake Valley
artworks.artist: Andrew Joseph Russell
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered in front of a log cabin. The horizon is in the middle of the photograph, dividing the light sky from the darker land. In the background, there are rolling hills. The cabin is made of logs with a sod roof. The style resembles historical photography with a focus on early monochrome techniques. The color palette is sepia. People are in various poses near the cabin, some sitting on chairs or steps, and a dog is on the ground. An old wooden cart is visible to the right.

artworks.title: Plate 49. Brigham Young's Cotton and Woolen Factories
artworks.artist: Andrew Joseph Russell
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image features an aerial view of a rural landscape with agricultural fields, scattered buildings, and mountain ranges in the distance. The horizon line is high, set against the backdrop of mountains dominating the top portion of the scene. The brushstrokes emphasize the natural textures and contours of the fields and mountains. The color palette is monochrome sepia, giving an aged feel to the scene. Closest to us are plowed fields and a wooden fence leading the eye towards small buildings with gabled roofs. In the distance, rugged mountains blend into the sky with a soft, hazy effect.

artworks.title: Plate 50. Great Mormon Tabernacle
artworks.artist: Andrew Joseph Russell
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image features a large, dome-shaped building at the center. Surrounding the building are trees and a construction site or storage area with scattered materials. In the background, there are distant mountains under a clear sky. The color palette is primarily sepia-toned, with varying shades of brown and beige.

artworks.title: Members of Chief Pocatello’s Band, Northwestern Shoshone
artworks.artist: Charles William Carter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: The image displays five individuals with their full bodies visible. Three individuals are standing and two are seated. The person on the far left is standing with one hand on their hip and holds a rifle with the other. The person in the center is standing and holding a photograph in their left hand. The third standing individual is on the far right and is resting one hand on the shoulder of the seated person in front of them, holding a long staff in the other hand. The seated individuals are positioned at the front, resting their hands on something fur-covered. All five individuals have long, dark hair, parted in the middle, and falling freely down their shoulders. They are wearing a variety of patterned, traditional clothing, which includes long shirts, pants, and some fur accessories. Around them are patterned fabrics and furs. The individual on the far left wears a necklace with multi-layered strands. The background features a painted backdrop depicting trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Sioux Scouts, North Dakota
artworks.artist: D. F. Barry
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image features two Native American men. One is sitting on horseback while the other stands beside the horse. The man on the horse is wearing traditional attire with detailed beadwork and a feathered headdress. The standing man is similarly dressed, wearing an ornate headpiece adorned with feathers. Both men have long hair and wear jewelry. The horse is saddled and decorated with beads. The background shows a vast, open grassland under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Paha-Uza-Tanka
artworks.artist: Joel E. Whitney
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up in a seated position, facing slightly to the right of the camera. The person has distinctive facial features with high cheekbones, and their hair appears to be dark, partially concealed under a headdress. They are wearing a headdress adorned with multiple feathers, and around their shoulders is a thick, patterned blanket. The background is plain with a vignette effect that focuses attention on the individual. The image is framed in a sepia tone, giving it a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: Tall Bull, Cheyenne Chief
artworks.artist: American 19th Century
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Clinton and Jean Wright
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body who is seated in a formal position. His head is turned slightly to the side but facing forward, with a direct gaze into the camera. The man has a neutral expression. He is wearing a fur cap with colorful, protruding horns. He is wearing a detailed, rich plum-colored garment with a high collar and a pattern in the fabric. A greenish-brown blanket or robe is draped over his lap. The man has large and intricate earrings. He is sitting on a chair with fringe, and behind him is a plain background with a worn or aged appearance.

artworks.title: Portrait of Nine Native Americans
artworks.artist: Edward Anthony, Mathew B. Brady
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image consists of nine individuals, some seated and others standing, showing their full bodies. At the center, a man is seated on a wooden chair, holding a large bow and arrows, and is dressed in traditional clothing with a headband and long hair. Surrounding him are both men and women in different poses; one woman is seated on the floor to the left wearing a decorative headband. The individuals wear traditional garments such as beads and patterned fabrics, with some adorned with feathers or furs. Several others also wear headbands, and one man on the right wears a dark suit with beads and holds a stick resembling a staff. The background is plain and neutral, likely intended to draw focus on the subjects. The image appears to be a studio photograph with a carpet or floor covering visible underfoot.

artworks.title: Clark & Moore, Merced River, Yosemite
artworks.artist: Eadweard Muybridge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Diana and Mallory Walker
artworks.description: The image shows a low viewpoint across a calm body of water with boulders scattered throughout. The water is smooth and reflective, while the horizon is obscured by tall coniferous trees. In the distance, layers of trees are visible with a hint of mist softening their appearance. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Rocks frame the water's edge, leading the eye towards the distant trees, creating a tranquil and majestic scene.

artworks.title: Jacob Meyer-Heine
artworks.artist: Félix Bracquemond
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an older man sitting by an open window. He is holding a book or newspaper and has a thoughtful expression on his face. The man has a full beard and mustache, wavy hair, and is wearing a jacket over a vest with a collared shirt and necktie or cravat. The background includes a lightly wooded area outside the window with trees and bushes along a path that leads into the distance. An inscription in Italian, "a mon ami Valentin," is also included alongside the artist's name.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Goose
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird skeleton. It shows the skeletal structure of a bird with a curved neck, detailed rib cage, limbs, vertebrae, and skull. The background is minimalistic. There is Latin text at the top. The drawing is an etching with fine lines and detailed rendering. It is commonly used in anatomical illustration and studies.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Camel
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a camel skeleton. The drawing depicts the full skeleton of a camel with detailed bones including the curved spine, rib cage, and elongated legs. The skull is prominently featured with the eye sockets and nasal cavity clearly detailed. An inscription in Latin is above the image. The background is plain and the ground is simply drawn. The style is reminiscent of historical anatomical studies focusing on accuracy and educational purposes.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Gurnard
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a fish skeleton in a monochromatic color palette. The fish skeleton extends from the head to the tail, positioned diagonally across the image. Below the fish, there is text in Latin, and the artist's inscription "Pesce Cappone" is near the lower right of the fish's head.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Rabbit
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton of a rabbit. The drawing depicts the skeletal structure of a rabbit in a detailed side view. The skeleton is shown in a standing posture, with elongated limbs and a curved spine, illustrating the distinctive skeletal features of a rabbit. The ribs, vertebrae, and skull are finely delineated. To the right of the skeleton, there are illustrations of small flowers and leaves. There is also a Latin inscription above the skeleton. The line work is precise and clean.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Turkey
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird skeleton labeled "Gallo de Indio" at the bottom. The intricate details show the arrangement of the bones, with features such as ribs, spine, limbs, and skull clearly visible. The drawing is marked by fine lines and shading, creating a detailed anatomical illustration. The background has text in a calligraphic style at the top.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Frog
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal structure resembling that of a creature. The drawing depicts an animal skeleton presented in a stylized, anatomical view, with detailed emphasis on the form and shape of the bones. The creature is shown with its spine slightly curved, limbs bent, and its bones intricately detailed. Above the skeletal form is a textual element that contains Latin script. The drawing has a gothic or medieval aesthetic, with bold, fine lines denoting bone structure.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Starling
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a bird skeleton on a tree branch. The drawing shows the detailed skeletal structure of a small bird, with emphasis on the ribs, wings, and leg bones. The bird is situated on a branch with few leaves in a natural setting. The background is a plain canvas with a Latin inscription at the top. The illustration showcases the fragile and complex skeletal system of the bird, highlighting the delicate bones and their arrangement for perching.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Quadruped
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an animal skeleton. The drawing shows the skeletal structure of an animal. The skeleton features a curved spine, detailed ribcage, limb bones, and a skull with prominent eye sockets and a jaw. The illustration is placed on a textured or creviced surface. Above the skeleton is an inscription in Latin script.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Tortoise
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a turtle or tortoise skeleton. The image shows the bony structure of a turtle or tortoise, including its carapace and skeletal limbs. The drawing is detailed, monochrome, and focused on the anatomical features of the creature. Text is above and below the illustration, and the drawing is framed by a simple border.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Bat
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: The image shows an anatomical illustration of a bat's skeleton. It features elongated wing bones, a rib cage, and a skull. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink lines on a cream or light beige background. The skeleton is sideways, with its wings spread to the left side and its rib cage in the center. There is Latin text above the skeletal depiction and a small label "Pippistrello" on the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Boar
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeleton of a wild boar. The illustration showcases the skeletal structure of a boar in a side view, focusing on the bones including the ribcage, spine, and legs. The skull is featured, showing the tusks. The background is plain and there is Latin text at the top.

artworks.title: Skeleton of a Heron
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Virginia Mars
artworks.description: This is a print of a bird skeleton standing upright, with the wings slightly raised. The detailed rendering highlights individual bones and joints, including as the skull, which is turned to the left, the spine, and the rib cage. Near the bottom right corner, there is a small section of text. The background is off-white paper, and the print is surrounded by a thin rectangular border.
